rules: Lock faces to A2 Week 1: Mei bob + pink bag; Priya ponytail + blue bag; navy pinafore.
Singapore English, standard grammar, no lah/ah. Aunty is capitalised.
Mei/Priya voices age 6-7. Aunty is motherly and higher, not pitched down old.
Every mouth beat needs speech. Never pad silence while a mouth is open.
Audio first, then animate that speaker. One speaker per generated clip.
Two people at once = two clips overlaid, not one two-shot generation.
Chest-up. Clip length equals the wav, not a padded 10 seconds.
Keep A2 W0 targets: Is this your…?; my/your; the; Thank you, Aunty.

beats.line: Oh no! Where is my water bottle? I cannot find it.
Let's go to the Lost and Found. OK.
Is this your white water bottle with the pink flower?
Yes, Aunty! That is my white water bottle!
Here you are. Please take it.
